topic: Simons & Chabris (1999) Invisible Gorilla, Memmert (2006) 1-Second Eye Tracking & Drew (2013) 83% Expert Scan Blindness (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Trafton Drew, Melissa Võ & Jeremy Wolfe (2013) embed a gorilla 48x larger than a lung spot into chest scans: 20 of 24 (83%) expert doctors miss it despite staring directly at it on eye-tracking.
